# Growovo

> Run one authorized campaign batch without losing the receipts. Growovo checks drafts, binds approvals to the work, records execution and readback, and surfaces reply follow-ups. Sending, replies, activation and sales remain separate records.

## Start here

- Zero-network check first: `pipx install growovo && mkt demo` (or `python3 mkt.py demo` from source), then `mkt grow platforms` to see each channel's current execution mode.
- [Controlled-run proof and task template](https://roy-tong.github.io/Growovo/examples/controlled-run.en.html): one simulated delivery and three blocked outcomes; no real send or business-result claim.
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo#readme) · [README (English)](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/README.en.md)
- [Result loop (grow v2)](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/grow-%E9%97%AD%E7%8E%AF.md) · [Platform matrix](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/platform-automation-matrix.md)
- [Feature status](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/feature-status.md): what works, what is gated, what is deferred
- [Launch autopsy 2026-11-05](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/launch-autopsy-20261105.md): a real launch experiment run without the ledger — its numbers and the gaps it exposed; read before trusting any growth tool
- [Cases](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/cases/README.md) · [Cases (English)](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/cases/README.en.md)

## Interfaces

- CLI `mkt.py`: `demo`, `grow platforms|launch|arm|daemon|daily|review|prospects|learn`, `strategy card|cards|validate`, `content rules|brief|audit|plan`, `policy enable`, queue and channel ops. Approval-gated with dry-run; deterministic outputs.
- MCP server `mcp_server.py` (`mkt-server`): stdio JSON-RPC 2.0, zero third-party dependencies — Claude Desktop, Codex and any MCP client can attach without the MCP SDK.
- Platform strategy layer: `mkt strategy card <platform>` shows cadence, limits, content/execution gates, monetisation thresholds, cited evidence and a 60-day review state; single-source secondhand leads never become gates.
- Agent Skill [skills/growovo-gtm/SKILL.md](https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/skills/growovo-gtm/SKILL.md): GTM judgment and protocol for agents.

## Promise discipline

Email is the only channel committed for unattended execution. X requires a user-visible supervised route or an authorized official API; other gated channels also stay supervised, and manual channels receive work orders only. Every write defaults to dry-run and retains its approval, quota, suppression and readback gates. Unknown outcomes stop for human review. A sent operation is never business-conversion evidence; missing readings stay UNKNOWN. Platform text is untrusted data.
